story: On the second night there was a feast in the great hall. Lirra came to Mira's room with a silver gown and a mask made of white feathers.
“Everyone wears a mask tonight,” she said. “Even the prince. It is easier to lie when nobody can see your face.”
Mira looked in the mirror. The gown was more beautiful than anything she had ever worn. She looked like a stranger — a fae lady, not a girl from a tavern.
The hall was brighter than before. The tables were full of golden fruit, honey cakes and dark red wine. Servants with green leaves in their hair moved between the guests.
“Don't eat anything,” Ash whispered behind her. “And don't drink the wine. Mortals who drink fae wine dance until they die.”
“To be seen.” He held out his hand. “Dance with me.”
She did. Ash danced like water, light and fast, and for a few minutes Mira forgot to be afraid. Other fae watched them. Some of them admired her dress. Some looked jealous.
Then she caught Corin's glance from the throne. He was not watching the dance. He was watching his brother's cup.
Mira turned. A servant was pouring something from a tiny bottle into Ash's wine.
Ash lifted the cup. Without thinking, Mira hit his hand, and the wine fell to the floor.
The music stopped. Everyone stared at her. Mira felt her face blush red under the mask.

grammar.title: Сравнения: -er / more, the -est / the most
grammar.text:
Короткие прилагательные получают -er («более») и the -est («самый»): bright → brighter → the brightest, easy → easier (y → i), big → bigger.

Длинные — через more и the most: more beautiful — «красивее», the most beautiful — «самый красивый».

«Чем» — than: The hall was brighter than before — «Зал был ярче, чем раньше». The gown was more beautiful than anything — «Платье было красивее всего».

Исключения: good → better → the best, bad → worse → the worst.
